description: This file defines a DialogFragment class for fingerprint authentication with fallback to password. It manages fingerprint enrollment, authentication, UI updates, and communication with a backend for verification.

classes.name: FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment managing fingerprint authentication with fallback to password, interacting with backend server for verification, and handling UI states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes fragment, registers enrollment, sets style and retain instance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes UI components, sets clicklisteners, and determines if fingerprint auth is available.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts listening for fingerprint authentication if in fingerprint stage.

methods.name: setCryptoObject
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic object for fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: goToBackup
methods.description: Switches UI to password fallback mode.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls user with backend by providing the public key from Android Keystore.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies entered password against backend, updates preferences, and proceeds with transaction if successful.

methods.name: updateStage
methods.description: Updates UI based on current authentication stage.

methods.name: onEditorAction
methods.description: Handles IME action listener for password input.

methods.name: onAuthenticated
methods.description: Handles successful fingerprint authentication, signs transaction, and verifies with backend.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles fingerprint errors, switches to password fallback.
